# Data Storage Lab

Canonical URL: https://datastoragelab.com/

Data Storage Lab provides vendor-neutral planning tools for home and small-team storage. Capacity, RAID availability, independent backup, and media selection are treated as separate decisions.

Current public areas:
- Storage needs: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/storage-needs/
- NAS configuration: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/nas-configuration/
- NAS Bay, Drive Count & Capacity Planner: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/nas-configuration/nas-bay-drive-capacity-planner/
- RAID Capacity Calculator: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/nas-configuration/raid-capacity-calculator/
- RAID Protection Decision Tool: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/nas-configuration/raid-protection-decision-tool/
- NAS Expansion Headroom Planner: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/nas-configuration/nas-expansion-headroom-planner/
- HDD vs SSD Storage Planner: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/nas-configuration/hdd-vs-ssd-storage-planner/
- CMR vs SMR Suitability Checker: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/nas-configuration/cmr-vs-smr-suitability-checker/
- RAID guide: https://datastoragelab.com/guides/raid-is-not-a-backup/
- RAID formulas: https://datastoragelab.com/reference/storage-raid-capacity-formulas/
- Bay-class comparison: https://datastoragelab.com/compare/2-bay-vs-4-bay-nas/
